title: Lost Mary Orange Juice 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Lost Mary Orange Juice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid brings the vibrant, sun-drenched taste of citrus to your vape kit. This blend captures the authentic experience of freshly squeezed Oranges, perfectly balancing a juicy, natural sweetness with the signature tangy notes of the fruit. The profile remains smooth throughout, delivering a consistently bright and uplifting citrus flavour that feels remarkably clean and refreshing on the exhale. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Lost Mary Nic Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Lost Mary Nic Salts collection delivers the same intense and globally popular flavours that made their single-use devices famous, now in a convenient 10ml refillable format. Beyond the zesty Orange Juice, vapers can explore other vibrant options within the range, such as the delicate Blueberry Rose Mint or the rich Strawberry Cherry Raspberry. It is the perfect choice for those seeking a premium, flavour-packed experience in a more cost-effective format. Compatible with refillable pod vape or vape starter kit UK devices for smooth hits.
